MoviNight

Settings

App zoom

Make the entire interface comfortable to read. Your choice is saved on this device.

Offline library & Discover cache

Keep fetched TMDB metadata and downloaded images on this device. Online browsing fetches current data; saved pages are used when TMDB cannot be reached.

Reading local cache…

Clear removes Discover results and artwork only. Other search/reference downloads remain. Saved-library metadata and images, your watched dates, and your waitlist are preserved. Old browsing entries are removed first when space is needed. The limit is a ceiling, not preallocated disk space. Trailers still require internet.

Get a free key from TMDB.

Your library stays yours

Existing watched dates, seasons and waitlist entries are preserved. Updates use the same saved-data folder, with backups before changes.

Connect your AI agent

Stopped

Start a local connection for Codex or another MCP client. Keep MoviNight open. Your agent can propose matches; you approve them here.

Use Streamable HTTP and the token as a Bearer header. A local MCP client must be configured first; copying the guide alone does not connect it. Remote AI services cannot directly reach this address.

MCP documentation

Copy the full connection instructions, tools and workflow examples. Available even when the server is stopped.
